verdict.rationale: Apify lets a developer start a scraping Actor such as apify/web-scraper on a URL with one client call that waits for the run to finish (apify-docs-15, apify-docs-23). Results then come back through a separate dataset retrieval step (apify-docs-16, apify-docs-24), and nothing in the evidence shows the raw HTML of the page being returned. missing for 10: a documented single-request endpoint that returns a page's raw HTML directly, evidence that output can contain raw HTML rather than extracted data, and hands-on corroboration.
